caseName: Watts v. Ely Real Estate & Investment Co.
caseNameFull: Cornelius C. Watts v. Ely Real Estate & Investment Company
summary: Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. S. L. Kingan, Mr. Herbert Noble and Mr. Hartwell P. Heath for petitioners. Mr. Selim M. Franklin for respondent.

opinions.text: Motion to dismiss the petition for writ of certiorari in this case for want of prosecution granted.
